veranderings.voor: Die harde deel van die kop wat om die brein pas.
veranderings.na: Die harde deel wat in die kop om die brein pas.
veranderings.rede: The relative clause 'wat om die brein pas' directly follows 'die kop', so it can be read as the head fitting around the brain; moving it next to 'deel' removes the ambiguity without changing the meaning.
The legs sit on (aan) the thorax, as the study text says ('Aan die borsstuk sit ses pote'); 'waaraan' is the correct prepositional relative and ties the clause clearly to the part, not to 'liggaam'.
